title: Kong and Solace connect APIs, events, and AI traffic
summary: The technology partnership expands Kong's governed data-path story into real-time event streams. It is strategically relevant, while its adoption and economics remain unknown.
confirmed: Solace joined Kong's Premium Technology Partner Program.
The companies described a combined control plane for APIs, events, LLMs, and MCP servers with shared governance and observability.
uncertain: The announcement did not disclose customer deployments, commercial terms, bookings, or revenue contribution.
